kurals.tr: Ilvaazhvaan Enpaan Iyalputaiya Moovarkkum / Nallaatrin Nindra Thunai
kurals.m: He will be called a (true) householder, who is a firm support to the virtuous of the three orders in

kurals.tr: Thurandhaarkkum Thuvvaa Dhavarkkum Irandhaarkkum / Ilvaazhvaan Enpaan Thunai
kurals.m: He will be said to flourish in domestic virtue who aids the forsaken, the poor, and the dead

kurals.tr: Thenpulaththaar Theyvam Virundhokkal Thaanendraangu / Aimpulaththaaru Ompal Thalai
kurals.m: The chief (duty of the householder) is to preserve the five-fold rule (of conduct) towards the manes, the Gods, his guests, his relations and himself

kurals.tr: Pazhiyanjip Paaththoon Utaiththaayin Vaazhkkai / Vazhiyenjal Egngnaandrum Il
kurals.m: His descendants shall never fail who, living in the domestic state, fears vice (in the acquisition of property) and shares his food (with others)

kurals.tr: Anpum Aranum Utaiththaayin Ilvaazhkkai / Panpum Payanum Adhu
kurals.m: If the married life possess love and virtue, these will be both its duty and reward

kurals.tr: Araththaatrin Ilvaazhkkai Aatrin Puraththaatril / Pooip Peruva Thevan?
kurals.m: What will he who lives virtuously in the domestic state gain by going into the other, (ascetic) state ?

kurals.tr: Iyalpinaan Ilvaazhkkai Vaazhpavan Enpaan / Muyalvaarul Ellaam Thalai
kurals.m: Among all those who labour (for future happiness) he is greatest who lives well in the household state

kurals.tr: Aatrin Ozhukki Aranizhukkaa Ilvaazhkkai / Norpaarin Nonmai Utaiththu
kurals.m: The householder who, not swerving from virtue, helps the ascetic in his way, endures more than those who endure penance

kurals.tr: Aran Enap Pattadhe Ilvaazhkkai / Aqdhum Piranpazhippa Thillaayin Nandru
kurals.m: The marriage state is truly called virtue The other state is also good, if others do not reproach it

kurals.tr: Vaiyaththul Vaazhvaangu Vaazhpavan Vaanu�ryum / Theyvaththul Vaikkap Patum
kurals.m: He who on earth has lived in the conjugal state as he should live, will be placed among the Gods who dwell in heaven
